plot_precision_recall_binary: plot a precision-recall curve for a binary classifier using from_estimator
plot_precision_recall_predictions: plot a precision-recall curve from precomputed classifier predictions and scores
compute_precision_recall_curve: compute precision-recall curve values for each class in multi-label classification
